Alexa, saw Bitsight was named a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Risk Ratings and a Visionary in the 2026 Gartner MQ.

Analyst momentum like that usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the message lands. That is where pipeline goes cold: reps spend hours on research, writing, and CRM instead of meetings. Our AI SDR runs all of that autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, around 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Bitsight off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, so reps spend more time in conversations. Our best-practice patterns alone tend to lift response rates 50-70%, and I'll show where Bitsight's sequence is likely leaking replies.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise security motion? I'll tailor it to Bitsight either way, and it's yours regardless.
